name: V960 Mon

paper.title: The environment around young eruptive stars. SPHERE/IRDIS polarimetric imaging of 7 protostars

notes: FUor object in outburst since 2014, with a close (0.2 arcsec) stellar companion; SPHERE polarized-light imaging reveals huge spiral arms extending thousands of au (Zurlo et al. 2024). Detailed treatment, including evidence for planetary-mass clumps, presented in Weber et al. 2023b.
